div.head: Cn 1018 16
div.ab: And sy ælc wuduwe þe hy silfe mid rihte gehealde. on godes griðe 7 on ðæs cynges.
And sy ælc wuduwe þe hy silfe mid rihte gehealde on Godes griðe and on ðæs cynges.
And let every widow who conducts herself in a proper manner be in the protection of God and the king.
And all widows who comport themselves properly shall be under the protection of God and the king.
